   **Bugs and stability.**
      16 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Sep 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tamia413_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "App is now too glitchy to use, makes typing a little more diffficult on mobile as the screen keeps moving every time I type."
            2. _Yacyii_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "The performance on iPad is TERRIBLE. The screen keeps randomly jumping from one place to another, and there are so many bugs that it’s really difficult to work with the app comfortably. It’s extremely frustrating and honestly makes the whole experience exhausting. I’m using a 2025 iPad, so I really don’t think this should be happening. Please fix the iPad experience and these annoying bugs!"
            3. _.oliviaaa_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
